title: Generated unit tests for buildReportSpecFromState
body: Added 5 tests for buildReportSpecFromState() in SRC/preact/tests/core/state.test.ts (lines 223-281). Covers: all 6 fields present, value pass-through with reference identity checks, detailBands fallback for undefined and null, and top-level object isolation. Typecheck required `mode: 'math'` on CalcStage objects and `as unknown as Record<string, unknown>` for the AppState mutation casts. All 677 tests pass, typecheck clean, lint 0 errors.

title: Integration test for ingestSheet colTypes storage
body:
Created `preact/tests/ui/loader-ingestion-coltypes.test.ts` — 6 integration tests verifying that `ingestSheet()` stores `colTypes` on `DbTable` via the reactive store. Key decisions:
- Mocked `XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json` on globalThis (same pattern as export-bands.test.ts)
- Used dense `!data` format for mock worksheets with `!ref` to pass the guard at loader.ts:212
- Called `initStore()` in beforeEach for fresh state per test
- Used `getStore()` singleton (matches how `getTableColor()` resolves in utils.ts)
- Table ID computed as `t_<label_slugified>` per loader.ts:230
- Empty sheet and non-dense sheet scenarios verify early return (table not created)
- `_rowno` exclusion verified explicitly
- Date-format override (numeric cells with date z-format) verified end-to-end
All 6 tests pass, lint clean, full suite green (929/929).

title: Export additions for testability: BandHeaderRenderer and BAND_ROW_TINTS
body: BandHeaderRenderer and BAND_ROW_TINTS were module-private in grid.tsx. Added `export` to both to enable direct unit testing. BandHeaderRenderer is an AG Grid imperative cell renderer (init/getGui/refresh/destroy contract) — testing it requires DOM access (jsdom handles this). The tint index stored in descriptorsToGridRows output is the raw sequential index; color cycling (modulo) happens in the styler/renderer, not in the row data generator.
